{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Imperial Space Dock Lianna-6''''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. The [[Lianna-class corvette|''Lianna''-class corvette]] ''[[Novar's Bluff]]'' was outfitted with an experimental [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] at the installation.
